messages:
Tess: Sunbeam in the west corner seat is up for grabs. Who claims it? :sun_with_face:
Owen: I call it for sprint-nap duty. Low-key hot desk.
Rina: I volunteer as tribute — but only if I can bring a tiny fan.
Marco: Can we have a two-hour rotation? Sunbeam fairness committee. :gavel:
Tess: @Rina +fan approved. Also small one-liner contest: best sunlight pun wins the spot for 30 minutes.
Owen: "I'm just here for the solar perks."
Rina: "Seat of the sun — where my ideas get tan lines."
Marco: "I've been working on my ray-zing productivity."
HRBot: Micro-poll posted: Vote 🌞 for Owen, 🌿 for Rina, ⚡ for Marco — results in 3 minutes.
Owen: Also tiny PSA: headphones on in sunbeam zone — no live drum solos.
Rina: Noted. I will only hum quietly. :microphone:
Tess: Poll closed: Rina wins by 2 reactions. Sunbeam assigned. Please water the succulents if your tan-fueled enthusiasm gets high.
Marco: Congrats Rina. I expect a tan report later.
Rina: Will provide tan-chart and one-liner victory dance.
HRBot: Reminder: office plants are shared property; if you borrow sunlight, leave a sticky note. :memo:
Tess: Also kudos to Marco for organizing the fairness committee immediately. :clap:
